_comment: Interview knowledge the FL-150 field config cannot express. FL-150 comes in when DV-100 asks for child support or spousal support (DV-100 page 13: "If you are asking for child support or spousal support you must also complete form FL-150"), so nothing here asks whether support is wanted. The caption (party block, parties, court street, age, lawyer) is asked in the shapes DV-100 asks it, under DV-100's names, so in the packet every one of those collapses into DV-100's answer. Page 4 is headed "Fill out this page only if your case involves child support": its questions wait on DV-100's own "Child support" option through a choice that carries DV-100's orders question name and option names, which the packet collapses into DV-100 item 24's answer. Each table on the paper is asked the way the paper lists it: a check-all-that-apply list of what applies, then the amounts for what was ticked, last month and average per month side by side.

This is DV-100 item 24/25's own orders question: the same question name and the same option names and labels, so in the packet it collapses into DV-100's answer (collapseSharedQuestions in project-gui-export.js) and the page-4 questions wait on DV-100's "Child support". Do you know what percent of the time the children spend with each parent?

fl150_percent_time_with_me.text: What percent of the time do the children spend with you?
fl150_percent_time_with_me.subtitle: The rest of the time is counted as the other parent's.
fl150_percent_time_with_me._why: The paper prints the children's time with the filer and with the other parent, and the two make 100. Asked both, a filer could answer 100 and 100 - so only this one is asked and the other is worked out (computed remainderOf).

autofill.why: The declarant's signature date on page 1 has one correct answer and the form already knows it.
The printed name under the page 1 signature is the name the filer gave on DV-100 item 1a.

fl150_attorney_for._why: The caption's ATTORNEY FOR (name) is the filer's name when a lawyer represents them, and blank when the filer has no lawyer. DV-100's "Do you have a lawyer?" ticks has_lawyer_yes.

fl150_attorney_signature_date._why: Item 15's attorney signature date is dated with the fee information it confirms, and only when item 15 is answered.

fl150_pages_attached._why: Page 1's "Number of pages attached" counts the sheets added for more space. The packet adds none to FL-150, so the count is what is attached to it in the packet, which the form works out rather than asking.

fl150_percent_time_with_other_parent._why: The other parent's share of the children's time is what is left of 100 after the filer's: the two numbers the paper prints always add up.
